title: File:NASA-JSC S82-33031.jpg
art: NASA photographer Pat Patnesky took this photo of Marianne J. Dyson in Mission Control during STS-4, July 1982.
desc:
Flight Activities Officer Marianne J. Dyson, a member of the STS-4 Entry Team, on console in Mission Control at Johnson Space Center.
The Mission Control Room for STS-4 was located on the second floor of Building 30 at Johnson Space Center in Houston, Texas. The FAO console was next to the Capcom.

title: File:CAPCOM Stephen Robinson during STS-103.jpg
desc: Astronaut Stephen K. Robinson, spacecraft communicator (CAPCOM), monitors a television downlink from the Space Shuttle Discovery during the first space walk for STS-103. Linda Ham, flight director, is in the background.

title: File:Duke, Lovell and Haise at the Apollo 11 Capcom, Johnson Space Center, Houston, Texas - 19690720.jpg
art: Photographer from the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) (http://www.nasa.gov), not named at the NASA
desc: Spacecraft communicators at the Lyndon B. Johnson Space Center in Houston, Texas, USA, keeping in contact with the Apollo 11 astronauts during their lunar landing mission on 20 July 1969. From left to right, they are astronauts Charles M. Duke Jr., James A. Lovell Jr. and Fred W. Haise Jr.
